//: Project-wide, committed, and it applies to everyone equally. Installed skills and the vendored design/.ui/ are build artifacts: a fix belongs upstream in the cairn repository, where every project gets it. Edited in place it survives until the next install and then silently reverts. Replacing a copy wholesale still works - this stops editing, not reinstalling. The OTHER restriction - keeping a designer out of the developers' folders, e.g. Edit(./app/**) - is a property of who is sitting at the machine rather than of the project, so it goes in .claude/settings.local.json on their laptop and never in this file, which everybody shares. Putting the two in one file locked a developer out of their own source code once already.
